composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114a "BILGE SYSTEM") is the electrical wiring/control sheet for the vessel's bilge system. It serves: (1) 520-main-bilge-pump — the MAIN BILGE PUMP motor and its multi-switch start circuit (top-right, confirmed by established engineer fact); (2) 520-bilge-valves — the five Burkert electric bilge valve actuators (Eng. Room Bilge valves ×5, driven by Re1-Re5 relays via T/S C open/close contacts) and their five associated bilge float switches (Port Lazarette, Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Fwd, Sail Locker, Eng Room); (3) 641-vessel-control-panel — the MAIN PANEL / PLUG C / PLUG D / PC CARD status and switch section is the vessel control panel's own hardware, hosting the bilge system's remote switches (S20-S24, S13) and status lamps, but is itself the panel node; (4) 652-onyx-monitoring — the XA40/XA10/XA11/XA1 taps and 'to ONYX' pointer are monitoring/remote-command links to the ONYX system per established fact. The pedestal alarm+mute module is part of the vessel control panel's alarm annunciation for bilge status.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' motor symbol top-right, fed via F3 60A / SW8 / SO6 and controlled via terminal strip T/S S (13/14/15) and the local pump switch. Matches established engineer fact for this exact drawing (GM-114a) describing the multi-switch activation loop.

functions.label: Main bilge pump run/start control (multi-source)
functions.what_it_does: Runs the main bilge pump motor; the solenoid/contactor coil that energises the pump can be closed from any of three independent sources: the LOCAL PUMP SW on this sheet, the MAIN PANEL bilge pump switch (S13, via Plug C pins 6/7), or a remote ONYX command (cable 7 into terminal 50 via relay Re6). This is one control loop with three alternate activation paths, per prior engineer trace.

flow_scenarios.path: F3 60A fuse -> SW8 -> SO6 solenoid supply standing by; T/S S terminals 13/14/15 idle; pump motor de-energised
LOCAL PUMP SW closed -> T/S S terminal 13 (fused) and 14 -> SO6/relay coil closes -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor runs; local indicator lamp lit
MAIN PANEL bilge pump switch S13 closed -> Plug C pins 6/7 -> terminal strip -> coil closes -> pump runs; status echoed to PC card indicator
ONYX remote command via cable/tap XA11-32 -> terminal 50 -> relay Re6 -> coil closes -> pump runs (cross-reference: ONYX drawing)

functions.sheet_region: top-left (supply F3/SW8/SO6, T/S S) and top-right (pump motor); bottom-left (Re6/terminal 50/XA11) for ONYX path

good_to_have: F3 fuse rated 60A — value visible on sheet
SO6 device identity is a solenoid/contactor symbol, exact part not printed

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Five identical rows each labelled 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' with open/close switch contacts (T/S C terminals) driving a valve motor symbol, fed via relays Re1-Re5 from breaker Q13 10A (BILGE VALVES). Matches engineer-confirmed mapping BILGE VALVES -> 520-bilge-valves and BOM identity (Burkert actuators).

functions.label: Remote open/close of the five bilge valve actuators
functions.what_it_does: Each of the five Burkert electric bilge valve actuators (one per bilge zone: 3 x labelled Eng Room Bilge on this sheet's rows, serving different compartments per the switch bank) is opened or closed by a dedicated OPEN/CLOSE contact pair on T/S C, driven through its own relay (Re1-Re5) fed from breaker Q13 10A via T/S B.

flow_scenarios.path: Q13 10A (BILGE VALVES) -> T/S B terminals 8/9/10 -> Re1-Re5 relay contacts standing open; valve motors de-energised
OPEN contact closed (row 1: T/S C-7; row 2: T/S C-16; row 3: T/S C-24, etc.) -> relay energised -> valve motor runs open -> valve motor terminals T/S C [2]/[3] energise the actuator -> valve opens
CLOSE contact closed (row 1: T/S C-8; row 2: T/S C-17; row 3: T/S C-25, etc.) -> relay energised opposite polarity -> valve motor runs close -> valve closes

key_components: T/S C open/close contact terminals per row
Burkert electric rotary actuator on each DN050 ball valve
functions.sheet_region: center column, five stacked rows between T/S B/Re1-5 and T/S C terminals 7-47

functions.label: Bilge compartment level monitoring (float switches)
functions.what_it_does: Six bilge float/level switches (Port Lazarette, Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) report high-level status via the '<<' tapped lines routed from each valve's discharge line group back through T/S C, feeding status to the monitoring taps (XA40/XA10) and ultimately the Main Panel PC card open/closed indicators.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge switch open (no water) -> no signal on '<<' line
Bilge switch closes (float rises) -> signal via '<<' line -> T/S C terminal group -> XA40/XA10 status tap -> onward to Main Panel PC card lamp (open/closed indicator) and/or ONYX monitoring

functions.sheet_region: right-hand column, bilge switch boxes labelled per compartment

equipment_groups.dry_data: Supply: Q13 10A breaker labelled 'BILGE VALVES'; actuation via relays Re1-Re5, 24V DC control; 5x Burkert electric rotary actuators on Burkert 2-way DN050 ball valves (established BOM fact)
good_to_have: Exact relay part numbers not printed — Re1-Re5 identified by label only
T/S C terminal numbers are dense/overlapping in places (e.g. 44-47) — legible but tight; capture exact numbers at inspection if needed

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: MAIN PANEL / PLUG C / PLUG D / PC CARD block is explicitly labelled 'MAIN PANEL', matching engineer mapping MAIN PANEL -> 641-vessel-control-panel. Hosts remote switches S20-S24 (bilge zone selectors) and S13 (bilge pump switch) plus PC card open/closed lamps and the pedestal alarm+mute module — all panel hardware, not bilge-system hardware itself.

functions.label: Bilge status display and remote switching hub
functions.what_it_does: Provides the main-panel operator interface for the bilge system: switches S20-S24 select/command each bilge zone (Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) via Plug C into the bilge-valve control loop on T/S C; the PC card shows open/closed lamp status per zone; S13 is the panel bilge-pump start switch; a pedestal alarm module with mute sounds/silences a bilge alarm condition.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge valve open/closed contact state -> Plug D pins 1-10 -> PC card open/closed lamp pairs per zone (Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker)
Panel switch S20/S21/S22/S23/S24 -> Plug C pins 1-5 -> onward wiring to the corresponding bilge valve OPEN/CLOSE contact on T/S C
S13 switch -> Plug C pins 6/7 -> to main bilge pump control loop (see 520-main-bilge-pump)
Alarm module speaker/lamp driven by status taps (PLUG D pins 8-11) -> mute switch silences audible alarm locally at pedestal

functions.sheet_region: bottom half of sheet, MAIN PANEL / PLUG C / PLUG D / PC CARD boxes

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: XA40/XA10/XA11/XA1 tags are ONYX-loom status/command taps per sheet convention and established engineer fact naming XA40/XA10 as status taps and XA11 as the ONYX remote command path for the bilge pump; 'to ONYX' explicit pointer confirms.

functions.label: Monitoring/remote-command interface for bilge valves and pump
functions.what_it_does: Receives status taps from each bilge valve relay (XA40 <14>,<12>,<16> off Re1/Re2; XA10 <06>,<04>,<02> off Re3/Re4/Re5) for remote monitoring, and provides one remote start command path (XA11 <32>) into the main bilge pump's Re6/terminal-50 control loop.

flow_scenarios.path: Re1/Re2/Re3/Re4/Re5 relay coil output -> XA40/XA10 tap -> off-sheet ONYX loom (cross-reference)
ONYX command -> XA11-32 tap -> terminal 50 -> Re6 -> closes main bilge pump start circuit (see 520-main-bilge-pump F1)

functions.sheet_region: left column, XA-labelled taps beside each relay

facts: +24V SERVICE BAT. feeds F2 200A main fuse (left rail, bottom-to-top run) — infrastructure supply, not itself a bilge-system component
F3 60A separately feeds SW8/SO6 for the main bilge pump branch

T/S B, T/S C, T/S S terminal strips and the Re1-Re6 relay bank chassis are shared distribution hardware; ownership of specific relay FUNCTIONS is attached to the equipment they drive (bilge valves / bilge pump) per engineer rule, but the strip/rack layout itself is infrastructure

Main Panel PC Card wiring continuation and Plug C/D full pinout beyond bilge rows
Main bilge pump supply fuse F3 60A / breaker origin and DC distribution bus
Bilge valve breaker Q13 10A origin panel
